operations.description: Spread a colloidal dispersion onto a substrate. TEM preparation uses a drop on carbon-coated copper grids, wicks excess solvent with filter paper and dries in air. quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of all six supplied main pages, six figures, Table 1 and bibliography entries 1–20, including bounded R2 corrections, passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: All six supplied main pages, six figures, Table 1 and bibliography entries 1–20 read; SI and cited full sources unreviewed.

Table 1 visibly prints approximately 46, 35 and 1.52 nm without clear range separators; the adjacent prose separately reports 4–5.5, 3–5 and 1.5–2 nm. These are preserved side by side, not silently repaired.
Table 1 has blank continuation cells. Filled values are source reported; continued group settings are labelled inherited rather than independently reported for that row.
Physical batch identities and many links between size-labelled figures and individual temperature/time rows are not supplied. Equal sizes do not establish a common batch.
No source coordinates, measured atomic unit cell, lattice-parameter number or unique ligand conformation are supplied. Chemically disordered fcc CoPt3 is distinct from particle superlattice packing.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
